101200101.text: ...Thank you for coming on such short notice, Honorary Knight. I know you must be busy.

101200102.text: Well, to make a long story short, there is a particular matter at hand that the Knights requires your assistance with.

101200104.text: *sigh* Yes, it has been one thing after another recently. Neither myself nor any of the Mondstadt garrison are able to catch a moment of peace.

101200107.text: I have recently received multiple reports from the Knights of someone within the Lawrence Clan having close dealings with the Fatui.

101200109.text: But who are the Lawrence Clan?

101200110.text: There was a dark period in Mondstadt's history when the aristocracy ruled over the city. The hard-won freedom that followed with the fall of Decarabian was lost once again, as slavery spread throughout the land.

101200111.text: The first Dandelion Knight, Vennessa, spearheaded the revolution that overthrew the old aristocratic system and established the Knights of Favonius, leading Mondstadt to become the city that you see today.

101200112.text: The aristocrats, that had oppressed the people of Mondstadt, were none other than the Lawrence Clan.

101200113.text: Oh, Paimon gets it. So the clan's descendants are now scheming with the bad guys to carry out more dubious deeds?

101200114.text: ...We suspect as much, though we have yet to obtain any solid evidence. The reason I summoned you here today is to ask you to help us further investigate this matter.

101200106.text: I have been meaning to have a word with you if the occasion presented itself, but as you know, Mondstadt's safety must always be my first priority.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the former aristocrat in the city

101200208.text: Hmph! And I suppose you think that you can simply strut up here and greet me in such an ignoble and vulgar manner?

101200209.text: Given that I don't recognize you, I can only assume that you are a traveler of some variety. I'll have you know that you are speaking with the Schubert Lawrence, a blood descendant of the magnanimous nobility.

101200210.text: If you wish to address me, you'd best consider your words more carefully. Such nonchalant manners are inadmissible and will never do.

101200211.text: Now, if you're somehow capable of understanding anything I've said, then you will get down on your knees, apologize for your negligent actions, and give me a proper introduction. That is the appropriate etiquette!

101200212.text: That's etiquette? Paimon's never heard of something so complicated before!

101200213.text: Hmph, in former times when people knew their place and respected traditions, such conduct was only basic courtesy when greeting a nobleman.

101200214.text: And neglecting your manners would result in a swift whipping.

101200215.text: *sigh* But look at the world now, rules have been thrown to the wayside and manners forgotten. Ugh, I cannot bear to see such degradation.

101200207.text: "What's wrong"? Did you just say "what's wrong"?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the person by the city wall
Return to the Knights Headquarters and discuss the counterplan

101200401.text: You don't think twice before reaching for your sword, do you? Ugh... do you have any idea how long I've been tracking these targets?

101200402.text: ...And now you get to stake a claim. Hmph, you think you're stronger because you got to them first? Ugh... mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

101200405.text: That's right. I heard the commotion and came as swiftly as I could, only to find you two already fighting the Fatui. Not only that, you were making quick work of them, too!

101200406.text: If I didn't make my move, you would have been able to take all the credit!

101200407.text: Still, I'm glad you're unscathed. Confronting that number of Fatui at once can be dangerous.

101200410.text: Uh... Sorry, Paimon doesn't understand what you mean... but thanks for your concern.

101200411.text: Concern? Why would I be concerned for the safety of my arch-enemies?

101200412.text: "Arch-enemies"? Wait a minute! You were saying how glad you were that we were "unscathed" a second ago!

101200413.text: By which I meant, if you were injured, I'd have to escort two strangers guilty of stealing my targets all the way back to Mondstadt...

101200414.text: Which would mean you'd caused me even more trouble... my vengeance would be swifter still!

101200415.text: Huh? So that's how you see all this!

101200418.text: Paimon thinks she's pretty strange... Although, at least we can communicate with her.

101200419.text: You dare to call someone you've just met "strange"? Forget the aristocracy, that's rude even by normal standards!

101200420.text: Speaking of which... how do you know my name?

101200421.text: This is the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius. And speaking of rude, we're trying to investigate an aristocrat named Schubert Lawrence.

101200422.text: He's so obsessed with etiquette that he's not even willing to speak with us!

101200423.text: Hahaha! I understand now. That's my uncle alright.

101200424.text: But why do you mean to investigate him?

101200425.text: He may be secretly involved with the Fatui.

101200426.text: I see... Haha, you have some nerve defaming a family member right in front of me. I will have vengeance for this, too!

101200427.text: No, no, no! This is an assignment from Master Jean! It's just an investigation, that's all!

101200301.text: Well, if it isn't the Honorary Knight! I'm just on my way out to gather some intel. I didn't expect to run into you here!

101200302.text: Huh? Judging by your expression, you must have run into some trouble.

101200303.text: Master Jean tasked us with a special assignment, but things seem to have run aground for the moment.

101200306.text: No need to get down on yourself, sometimes things just don't turn out as planned. Even I can't guarantee useful intel every time I'm dispatched.

101200307.text: You just have to keep at it and never give up!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Stormbearer Mountains and find Eula

101200601.text: Schubert can be quite touchy, so it may not be easy to get along with him at first.

101200602.text: But as long as matters remain calm, then you should be able to come to friendly terms with him.

101200702.text: You mean that weird old aristocrat? I'm afraid I haven't seen him.

101200703.text: Members of the Lawrence Clan don't usually appear in front of the Knights of Favonius of their own accord.

101200704.text: Which is just as well. It would be a bother if it ended up affecting our logistical preparations.

101200705.text: Head up and have a look. Who knows, you might just find him.

subQuests.subQuestName: Witness the young woman defeat the final Fatuus

101200801.text: Hello, have you seen an aristocrat by the name of Schubert anywhere nearby?

101200802.text: Hmm, the name doesn't ring a bell, but there has been an odd fellow strolling around here recently.

101200803.text: He's always looking around, and sometimes he seems to stop to draw or note something down. To be honest, I've got no idea what he's up to.

101200804.text: If that sounds like the person you're looking for, just head towards the city wall and you'll most likely run into him.

101201101.text: Head to the Stormbearer Mountains — you should be able to find Eula there!

101201102.text: She's a great friend of mine. She'll help you for sure.

101209901.text: So this is what Master Jean meant by "difficult to get along with"?

101209902.text: *sigh* Let's head back and talk things over with her.

101209903.text: Who would've guessed the Knights have a member of the Lawrence Clan...

101209904.text: Well, if you want to learn about the conduct of the Lawrence clan, who better to ask than one of their own family members?

101209905.text: Huh, the Fatui? What are they doing here! Is that why Eula was sent on patrol here?

101209906.text: Ugh... let's fight first and talk later!
